+"""Parameterized, read-only PostgreSQL adapter for the existing Neon feedback schema."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator, Mapping
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import UUID
+
+import psycopg
+from psycopg.rows import dict_row
+from pydantic import Field, SecretStr, ValidationError
+
+from bmwow.ontology.models import Context, SqlLocator
+
+from .config import Configuration
+from .feedback import (
+    FeedbackCoverage,
+    FeedbackDataset,
+    FeedbackKnowledgeService,
+    FeedbackServiceConfig,
+    aspect_id,
+    feedback_id,
+    vehicle_id,
+)
+from .records import (
+    EvidenceReference,
+    FeedbackAspect,
+    FeedbackClassification,
+    FeedbackFilter,
+    FeedbackItem,
+    FeedbackPage,
+    FeedbackRetrieval,
+)
+
+DATA_LIMITATIONS = [
+    "The SQL import does not identify a source version or original file/CSV location.",
+    "Original unlabelled VFC classifications cannot be reconstructed from these tables.",
+    "Feedback dates are unknown; created_at is an import timestamp.",
+    "Feedback and aspect IDs resolve SQL read projections, not persisted ontology nodes.",
+    "SQL citations resolve the current import; immutable dataset snapshots are not available.",
+]
+SELECTION_POLICY = "Feedback Explorer ID ascending; parent limit applied before aspects."
+
+
+class NeonFeedbackConfig(Configuration):
+    dataset_key: str = Field(default="bmw-feedback", pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$")
+    default_limit: int = Field(default=200, ge=1)
+    max_limit: int = Field(default=5000, ge=1)
+    connect_timeout_seconds: int = Field(default=10, ge=1)
+    statement_timeout_ms: int = Field(default=15000, ge=1)
+
+
+class FeedbackStorageError(RuntimeError):
+    """Sanitized operational failure: no DSN, feedback text, or SQL parameters in the message."""
+
+
+def _where(filters: FeedbackFilter) -> tuple[str, list[Any]]:
+    clauses, params = [], []
+    for column, values in (
+        ("derivate_code", [value.strip().upper() for value in filters.models]),
+        ("country", [value.strip().upper() for value in filters.markets]),
+        ("source", filters.sources),
+    ):
+        if values:
+            clauses.append(f"{column} = ANY(%s)")
+            params.append(values)
+    if filters.engine_types:
+        values = [value.strip().upper().replace("BEVE", "BEV") for value in filters.engine_types]
+        known = [value for value in values if value != "UNKNOWN"]
+        predicate = "engine_type = ANY(%s)"
+        if "UNKNOWN" in values:
+            predicate = f"({predicate} OR engine_type IS NULL)"
+        clauses.append(predicate)
+        params.append(known)
+    if filters.since is not None:
+        # No observation date exists. Never turn the import timestamp into a customer event date.
+        clauses.append("FALSE")
+    return " AND ".join(clauses) or "TRUE", params
+
+
+def _locator(table: str, key: Any) -> SqlLocator:
+    return SqlLocator(
+        kind="sql", table=f"public.{table}", record_key=str(key), original_locator=None
+    )
+
+
+def _context(parent: Mapping) -> Context:
+    derivate, country, engine = (
+        parent.get("derivate_code"),
+        parent.get("country"),
+        parent.get("engine_type"),
+    )
+    engine = (engine or "unknown").lower().replace("beve", "bev")
+    return Context(
+        vehicle_model_ids=[vehicle_id(derivate)] if derivate else [],
+        market_ids=[],
+        country_codes=[country] if country else [],
+        engine_types=[engine if engine in {"ice", "phev", "bev"} else "unknown"],
+        as_of=None,
+        scope_notes=[
+            "Country and Derivate describe feedback coverage, not vehicle sale availability."
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def project_feedback(parent: Mapping, aspects: list[Mapping], dataset_key: str) -> FeedbackItem:
+    """Preserve imported Verbatim and all aspects; no inference is promoted to a graph Signal."""
+    item_id = feedback_id(dataset_key, parent["feedback_explorer_id"])
+    source_id = f"source:{dataset_key}"
+    context = _context(parent)
+    reference = EvidenceReference(
+        evidence_id=item_id,
+        source_id=source_id,
+        record_key=parent["feedback_explorer_id"],
+        locator=_locator("feedback_entries", parent["id"]),
+    )
+    projected, classifications = [], []
+    for value in aspects:
+        locator = _locator("feedback_aspects", value["id"])
+        quote = value.get("quote_snippet")
+        curated = value["extraction_source"] == "vfc_label"
+        status = (
+            "not_applicable"
+            if curated
+            else "missing"
+            if not quote or not quote.strip()
+            else "supported"
+            if quote in parent["raw_feedback"]
+            else "mismatch"
+        )
+        limitations = []
+        if status in {"missing", "mismatch"}:
+            limitations.append(
+                "This inferred aspect has no exact supporting Quote in the imported Verbatim."
+            )
+        if curated:
+            limitations.append(
+                "The original VFC label is curated; this does not establish human authorship "
+                "of the coarse buckets or Sentiment Score."
+            )
+            classifications.append(
+                FeedbackClassification(
+                    feedback_type=value.get("feedback_type"),
+                    # Legacy names carry original Aspect Term/Label, not the coarse SQL buckets.
+                    vfc_category=value.get("aspect_term"),
+                    vfc_issue=value.get("aspect_label_raw"),
+                    vfc_combined=None,
+                    attribute=None,
+                    mapping_status=None,
+                    locator=locator,
+                )
+            )
+        projected.append(
+            FeedbackAspect(
+                aspect_id=aspect_id(dataset_key, str(value["id"])),
+                locator=locator,
+                feedback_type=value.get("feedback_type"),
+                aspect_term=value.get("aspect_term"),
+                aspect_label=value.get("aspect_label_raw"),
+                vfc_category=value["vfc_category"],
+                issue_type=value["issue_type"],
+                sentiment=value["sentiment"],
+                sentiment_score=value.get("sentiment_score"),
+                extraction_source=value["extraction_source"],
+                quote=quote,
+                quote_status=status,
+                imported_at=value.get("created_at"),
+                references=[reference.model_copy(deep=True)],
+                context=context,
+                limitations=limitations,
+            )
+        )
+    return FeedbackItem(
+        item_id=item_id,
+        text=parent["raw_feedback"],
+        channel=parent.get("source"),
+        market=parent.get("country"),
+        model=parent.get("derivate_code"),
+        engine_type=parent.get("engine_type"),
+        imported_at=parent.get("created_at"),
+        references=[reference],
+        context=context,
+        limitations=list(DATA_LIMITATIONS),
+        classifications=classifications,
+        aspects=projected,
+    )
+
+
+class NeonFeedbackRepository:
+    """Each operation owns one short read-only transaction and closes its connection."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        database_url: str,
+        config: NeonFeedbackConfig | None = None,
+        *,
+        connect: Callable = psycopg.connect,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not database_url.strip():
+            raise ValueError("DATABASE_URL is required for Neon feedback reads.")
+        self._database_url = SecretStr(database_url)
+        self._config = (config or NeonFeedbackConfig()).model_copy(deep=True)
+        if self._config.default_limit > self._config.max_limit:
+            raise ValueError("default_limit must not exceed max_limit.")
+        self._connect = connect
+
+    @property
+    def config(self) -> NeonFeedbackConfig:
+        return self._config.model_copy(deep=True)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_env(cls, config: NeonFeedbackConfig | None = None) -> NeonFeedbackRepository:
+        return cls(os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", ""), config)
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def _read(self) -> Iterator[Any]:
+        try:
+            with self._connect(
+                self._database_url.get_secret_value(),
+                connect_timeout=self._config.connect_timeout_seconds,
+                row_factory=dict_row,
+                prepare_threshold=None,
+            ) as conn:
+                conn.read_only = True
+                conn.isolation_level = psycopg.IsolationLevel.REPEATABLE_READ
+                conn.execute(
+                    "SELECT set_config('statement_timeout', %s, true)",
+                    (str(self._config.statement_timeout_ms),),
+                )
+                yield conn
+        except psycopg.Error:
+            raise FeedbackStorageError(
+                "Feedback database read failed. Check connectivity, credentials, and the "
+                "feedback schema; no fallback dataset was selected."
+            ) from None
+        except (ValidationError, KeyError, TypeError):
+            raise FeedbackStorageError("Feedback data does not match the read contract.") from None
+
+    def dataset(self) -> FeedbackDataset:
+        return FeedbackDataset(
+            source_id=f"source:{self._config.dataset_key}",
+            dataset_key=self._config.dataset_key,
+            limitations=list(DATA_LIMITATIONS),
+        )
+
+    def _project(self, conn, parents: list[dict]) -> list[FeedbackItem]:
+        if not parents:
+            return []
+        aspects = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT id, feedback_entry_id, feedback_type, vfc_category, aspect_term, "
+            "aspect_label_raw, issue_type, quote_snippet, sentiment, sentiment_score, "
+            "extraction_source, created_at FROM public.feedback_aspects "
+            "WHERE feedback_entry_id = ANY(%s::uuid[]) ORDER BY feedback_entry_id, id",
+            ([str(parent["id"]) for parent in parents],),
+        ).fetchall()
+        grouped: dict[str, list] = {}
+        for aspect in aspects:
+            grouped.setdefault(str(aspect["feedback_entry_id"]), []).append(aspect)
+        return [
+            project_feedback(parent, grouped.get(str(parent["id"]), []), self._config.dataset_key)
+            for parent in parents
+        ]
+
+    def read_feedback(self, filters: FeedbackFilter) -> FeedbackPage:
+        predicate, params = _where(filters)
+        requested = self._config.default_limit if filters.limit is None else filters.limit
+        limit = min(requested, self._config.max_limit)
+        with self._read() as conn:
+            total = conn.execute(
+                f"SELECT count(*) AS n FROM public.feedback_entries WHERE {predicate}", params
+            ).fetchone()["n"]
+            parents = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT id, feedback_explorer_id, source, brand, sales_description, country, "
+                "derivate_code, engine_type, raw_feedback, created_at "
+                f"FROM public.feedback_entries WHERE {predicate} "
+                'ORDER BY feedback_explorer_id COLLATE "C", id LIMIT %s',
+                [*params, limit],
+            ).fetchall()
+            items = self._project(conn, parents)
+        limitations = ["The retrieved corpus is not a representative customer-population sample."]
+        if total > len(items):
+            limitations.append(
+                "A bounded selection was returned; shares apply to selected feedback."
+            )
+        if requested > limit:
+            limitations.append(
+                f"The requested limit was capped at {self._config.max_limit} feedbacks."
+            )
+        if filters.since is not None:
+            limitations.append(
+                "The since filter excludes undated feedback; import dates are not used."
+            )
+        retrieval = FeedbackRetrieval(
+            total_matching=total,
+            returned_count=len(items),
+            truncated=total > len(items),
+            selection_policy=SELECTION_POLICY,
+            limitations=limitations,
+        )
+        for item in items:
+            item.retrieval = retrieval.model_copy(deep=True)
+            item.limitations.extend(limitations)
+        return FeedbackPage(items=items, retrieval=retrieval)
+
+    def coverage(self) -> list[FeedbackCoverage]:
+        with self._read() as conn:
+            rows = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT derivate_code, array_agg(DISTINCT country ORDER BY country) AS countries, "
+                "array_agg(DISTINCT engine_type ORDER BY engine_type) AS engine_types, count(*) AS n, "
+                "CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT brand) = 1 THEN min(brand) END AS brand, "
+                "CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT sales_description) = 1 THEN min(sales_description) "
+                "END AS sales_description FROM public.feedback_entries "
+                "WHERE derivate_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY derivate_code ORDER BY derivate_code"
+            ).fetchall()
+            return [
+                FeedbackCoverage(
+                    derivate=row["derivate_code"],
+                    countries=[c for c in row["countries"] if c],
+                    engine_types=[e for e in row["engine_types"] if e],
+                    feedback_count=row["n"],
+                    brand=row["brand"],
+                    sales_description=row["sales_description"],
+                )
+                for row in rows
+            ]
+
+    def find_feedback(self, feedback_explorer_id: str) -> FeedbackItem | None:
+        with self._read() as conn:
+            parents = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT id, feedback_explorer_id, source, brand, sales_description, country, "
+                "derivate_code, engine_type, raw_feedback, created_at "
+                "FROM public.feedback_entries WHERE feedback_explorer_id = %s",
+                (feedback_explorer_id,),
+            ).fetchall()
+            items = self._project(conn, parents)
+            return items[0] if items else None
+
+    def find_aspect(self, aspect_id: str) -> FeedbackAspect | None:
+        try:
+            UUID(aspect_id)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+        with self._read() as conn:
+            parents = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT f.id, f.feedback_explorer_id, f.source, f.brand, f.sales_description, "
+                "f.country, f.derivate_code, f.engine_type, f.raw_feedback, f.created_at "
+                "FROM public.feedback_entries f JOIN public.feedback_aspects a "
+                "ON a.feedback_entry_id = f.id WHERE a.id = %s::uuid",
+                (aspect_id,),
+            ).fetchall()
+            items = self._project(conn, parents)
+            target = f"aspect:{self._config.dataset_key}:{aspect_id}"
+            return next((a for item in items for a in item.aspects if a.aspect_id == target), None)
+
+
+def create_neon_feedback_service(
+    database_url: str | None = None,
+    *,
+    repository_config: NeonFeedbackConfig | None = None,
+    service_config: FeedbackServiceConfig | None = None,
+) -> FeedbackKnowledgeService:
+    repository = (
+        NeonFeedbackRepository.from_env(repository_config)
+        if database_url is None
+        else NeonFeedbackRepository(database_url, repository_config)
+    )
+    return FeedbackKnowledgeService(repository, service_config)

+"""Read contracts for knowledge consumers; these are not new ontology node types."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import datetime as dt
+from typing import Literal
+

+
+from bmwow.ontology.models import Context, Locator, Measurement, NumericRange
+
+
+class Record(BaseModel):
+    # Keep v1's permissive construction; declare the qualifications it must retain.
+    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True, extra="ignore")
+
+
+class EvidenceReference(Record):
+    evidence_id: str
+    source_id: str
+    record_key: str
+    locator: Locator
+
+
+class QualifiedRecord(Record):
+    references: list[EvidenceReference] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    context: Context | None = None
+    limitations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class AttributeValue(QualifiedRecord):
+    node_id: str
+    attribute: str
+    value: float | str
+    unit: str | None = None
+    source_note: str = ""
+    as_of: dt.date | None = None
+    value_range: NumericRange | None = None
+    measurement: Measurement | None = None
+    availability: (
+        Literal[
+            "announced", "standard", "optional", "available_unspecified", "unavailable", "unknown"
+        ]
+        | None
+    ) = None
+    epistemic_status: str | None = None
+
+
+class ModelNode(Record):
+    node_id: str
+    model_code: str | None = None
+    name: str
+    brand: str
+    segment: str
+    powertrain: str | None = None
+    # v1 registry field means dataset coverage. Portfolio queries use sold_regions.
+    regions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    sold_regions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    data_coverage: dict[str, list[str]] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    curation_note: str | None = None
+    attributes: list[AttributeValue] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class FeedbackClassification(Record):
+    feedback_type: str | None
+    vfc_category: str | None
+    vfc_issue: str | None
+    vfc_combined: str | None
+    attribute: str | None
+    mapping_status: Literal["proposed", "reviewed"] | None
+    locator: Locator
+
+
+class FeedbackAspect(QualifiedRecord):
+    """Imported aspect enrichment, separate from the original VFC classification."""
+
+    aspect_id: str
+    locator: Locator
+    feedback_type: str | None = None
+    aspect_term: str | None = None
+    aspect_label: str | None = None
+    vfc_category: str
+    issue_type: str
+    sentiment: Literal["Positive", "Negative", "Neutral"]
+    sentiment_score: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=-1, le=1)
+    extraction_source: Literal["vfc_label", "llm"]
+    quote: str | None = None
+    quote_status: Literal["supported", "missing", "mismatch", "not_applicable"]
+    imported_at: dt.datetime | None = None
+
+
+class FeedbackRetrieval(Record):
+    """Denominator and selection metadata for one bounded retrieval."""
+
+    total_matching: int = Field(ge=0)
+    returned_count: int = Field(ge=0)
+    truncated: bool
+    selection_policy: str
+    limitations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class FeedbackItem(QualifiedRecord):
+    item_id: str
+    text: str
+    channel: str | None
+    market: str | None = None
+    date: dt.date | None = None
+    rating: float | None = None
+    model: str | None = None

+"""Replaceable snapshot storage boundary; no database driver or schema assumptions."""
+
+from typing import Protocol
+
+from bmwow.ontology import GraphBundle, validate_bundle
+
+
+class SnapshotRepository(Protocol):
+    def load_snapshot(self) -> GraphBundle: ...
+
+
+class InMemoryRepository:
+    """An isolated, validated snapshot for synthetic integration and local development."""
+
+    def __init__(self, bundle: GraphBundle) -> None:
+        errors = validate_bundle(bundle)
+        if errors:
+            raise ValueError("Invalid knowledge snapshot:\n" + "\n".join(errors))
+        self._bundle = bundle.model_copy(deep=True)
+
+    def load_snapshot(self) -> GraphBundle:
+        return self._bundle.model_copy(deep=True)

+            raise ValueError("Search locale has no corresponding Market")
+        for profile in self._config.model_profiles.values():
+            if set(profile.sold_regions) - codes:
+                raise ValueError("Curated model availability has an unknown region")
+        for evidence_id, group in self._config.sales_groups.items():
+            evidence = self._nodes.get(evidence_id)
+            if (
+                not isinstance(evidence, Evidence)
+                or evidence.properties.evidence_kind != "sales_statistic"
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"Sales group has no corresponding sales Evidence: {evidence_id}")
+            if len(evidence.properties.context.vehicle_model_ids) < 2 or not group.strip():

+    def _references(self, node_id: str) -> list[EvidenceReference]:

+            else self._targets(node_id, "DERIVED_FROM")

+            EvidenceReference(

+    def _find_model(self, value: str) -> VehicleModel | None:
+        key = value.strip().casefold()

+            return None
+        matches = [
+            model
+            for model in self._models.values()
+            if key
+            in {
+                model.id.casefold(),
+                model.label.casefold(),
+                (model.properties.generation_code or "").casefold(),
+                *(alias.casefold() for alias in model.properties.aliases),
+            }
+        ]
+        if len(matches) > 1:
+            generations = [model for model in matches if model.properties.variant is None]
+            if len(generations) == 1:
+                return generations[0]
+            raise ValueError(f"Ambiguous model identity: {value}")
+        return matches[0] if matches else None

+        if context.market_ids:

+            )
+        return sorted(

+                kind = self._source(evidence).properties.source_kind
+                result.setdefault(kind, set()).update(self._regions(evidence.properties.context))

+        for model in sorted(self._models.values(), key=lambda node: node.id):

+    def list_competitor_models(
+        self, segment: str, regions: list[str], names: list[str] | None = None
+    ) -> list[ModelNode]:
+        # A profile alone cannot invent a competitor relation. COMPETES_WITH is mandatory.
+        linked = {
+            node_id
+            for edge in self._edges
+            if edge.type == "COMPETES_WITH"
+            for node_id in (edge.source_id, edge.target_id)

+    def get_taxonomy(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:

+    def get_attribute_values(
+        self, model_id: str, attributes: list[str] | None = None
+    ) -> list[AttributeValue]:
+        model = self._find_model(model_id)
+        if model is None:
+            raise KeyError(f"Unknown model: {model_id}")
+        result = []
+        for signal in sorted(self._bundle.nodes, key=lambda node: node.id):
+            if not isinstance(signal, Signal) or signal.properties.capability is None:
+                continue
+            properties = signal.properties
+            if model.id not in properties.context.vehicle_model_ids:
+                continue
+            feature_ids = [
+                node_id
+                for node_id in self._targets(signal.id, "CONCERNS")
+                if isinstance(self._nodes[node_id], Feature)
+            ]
+            capability = properties.capability
+            measurement = capability.measurement
+            for feature_id in feature_ids:
+                key = self._config.feature_keys.get(
+                    feature_id,
+                    "unmapped:" + re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "_", feature_id.lower()).strip("_"),
+                )
+                if attributes is not None and key not in attributes:
+                    continue
+                value = capability.availability
+                interval = measurement.value_range if measurement else None
+                if measurement is not None:
+                    value = (
+                        measurement.value
+                        if interval is None
+                        else f"{interval.minimum:g}–{interval.maximum:g}"
+                    )
+                notes = [
+                    properties.statement,
+                    f"availability={capability.availability}",
+                    f"countries={properties.context.country_codes or 'unknown'}",
+                    f"markets={self._regions(properties.context) or 'unknown'}",
+                    *(condition.description for condition in capability.conditions),
+                    *capability.notes,
+                ]
+                if measurement is not None:
+                    notes.append(measurement_text(measurement))
+                limitations = [
+                    limitation
+                    for ref in self._references(signal.id)
+                    for limitation in self._nodes[ref.evidence_id].properties.limitations
+                ]
+                result.append(
+                    AttributeValue(
+                        node_id=signal.id,
+                        attribute=key,
+                        value=value,
+                        value_range=interval,
+                        unit=measurement.unit if measurement else None,
+                        measurement=measurement,
+                        availability=capability.availability,
+                        epistemic_status=properties.epistemic_status,
+                        context=properties.context,
+                        references=self._references(signal.id),
+                        limitations=list(dict.fromkeys(limitations)),
+                        as_of=properties.context.as_of,
+                        source_note="; ".join(notes),

+                )
+        return [record.model_copy(deep=True) for record in result]

+    def get_feedback_items(self, filters: FeedbackFilter) -> list[FeedbackItem]:
+        wanted = {

+        }
+        result = []

+                if not engines & (set(context.engine_types) or {"unknown"}):

+            # These inputs do not establish a feedback date. A date filter cannot include undated rows.
+            if filters.since is not None:
+                continue
+            classifications = []
+            for classification in properties.raw_classifications:
+                mapping = self._config.vfc_mappings.get(classification.vfc_combined or "")
+                classifications.append(
+                    FeedbackClassification(

+    def sales_volume(

+        period_from: str | None = None,
+        period_to: str | None = None,
+    ) -> list[SalesRow]:
+        wanted = {model.id for value in models if (model := self._find_model(value)) is not None}
+        region_filter: set[str] = set()
+        for market in self._markets.values():
+            if markets and (
+                market.properties.code in markets
+                or set(markets) & set(market.properties.country_codes)
+            ):
+                region_filter.add(market.properties.code)
+        result = []
+        for evidence in sorted(self._bundle.nodes, key=lambda node: node.id):
+            if (
+                not isinstance(evidence, Evidence)
+                or evidence.properties.evidence_kind != "sales_statistic"
+            ):
+                continue
+            properties = evidence.properties
+            context = properties.context
+            measurement = properties.measurement
+            if not wanted & set(context.vehicle_model_ids):
+                continue
+            if measurement.period is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"Sales observation {evidence.id} has no reported period")
+            period = measurement.period.label
+            if (period_from and period < period_from) or (period_to and period > period_to):
+                continue
+            regions = self._regions(context)
+            if len(regions) != 1:
+                raise ValueError(f"Sales observation {evidence.id} needs one original region")
+            if markets and regions[0] not in region_filter:
+                continue
+            if (
+                measurement.statistic != "count"
+                or measurement.unit != "vehicles"
+                or measurement.value is None
+                or not measurement.value.is_integer()
+                or measurement.value < 0
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Sales observation {evidence.id} is not a scalar nonnegative count"
+                )
+            model_codes = [
+                self._models[node_id].properties.generation_code or self._models[node_id].label
+                for node_id in context.vehicle_model_ids
+            ]
+            group = self._config.sales_groups.get(evidence.id)
+            if len(model_codes) > 1 and not group:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Combined sales observation {evidence.id} needs an explicit source group"
+                )
+            result.append(
+                SalesRow(
+                    row_id=evidence.id,
+                    model=group or model_codes[0],
+                    model_codes=model_codes,
+                    source_group=group or model_codes[0],
+                    market=regions[0],
+                    period=period,
+                    units=int(measurement.value),
+                    status="actual"
+                    if measurement.temporal_status == "historical"
+                    else measurement.temporal_status,
+                    measurement=measurement,
+                    references=self._references(evidence.id),
+                    context=context,
+                    limitations=properties.limitations,
+                )
+            )
+        return [record.model_copy(deep=True) for record in result]

+    def search_documents(
+        self,
+        query: str,
+        kinds: list[str] | None = None,
+        regions: list[str] | None = None,
+        k: int = 10,
+    ) -> list[DocChunk]:
+        if k < 0:
+            raise ValueError("k must be nonnegative")
+        terms = set(re.findall(r"\w+", query.casefold()))
+        ranked = []
+        for evidence in self._bundle.nodes:
+            if not isinstance(evidence, Evidence):
+                continue
+            source = self._source(evidence)
+            source_kind = source.properties.source_kind
+            if source_kind not in {"customer_study", "industry_report", "global_indicator"}:
+                continue
+            kind = "study" if source_kind == "customer_study" else "report"
+            if kinds and kind not in kinds:
+                continue
+            properties = evidence.properties
+            scope = self._regions(properties.context)
+            if regions and not set(regions) & set(scope):
+                continue
+            text = properties.raw_text or ""
+            if properties.measurement is not None:
+                text += "\n" + measurement_text(properties.measurement)
+            text += "\nLimitations: " + "; ".join(properties.limitations)
+            overlap = len(terms & set(re.findall(r"\w+", (source.label + " " + text).casefold())))
+            if overlap == 0:
+                continue
+            publication = source.properties.publication_date
+            ranked.append(
+                (
+                    -overlap,
+                    evidence.id,
+                    DocChunk(
+                        node_id=evidence.id,
+                        doc_title=source.label,
+                        text=text,
+                        url=getattr(source.properties.location, "url", None),
+                        publication_label=publication,
+                        published=date.fromisoformat(publication)
+                        if publication and len(publication) == 10
+                        else None,
+                        regions=scope,
+                        kind=kind,
+                        measurement=properties.measurement,
+                        references=self._references(evidence.id),
+                        context=properties.context,
+                        limitations=properties.limitations,
+                    ),
+                )
+            )
+        return [chunk.model_copy(deep=True) for _, _, chunk in sorted(ranked)[:k]]

+    def resolve_citation(self, citation_id: str):
+        """Resolve v1 kg:/fb: identifiers to original graph objects, without fabricated nodes."""
+        node_id = citation_id
+        for prefix in ("kg:", "fb:"):
+            if node_id.startswith(prefix):
+                node_id = node_id[len(prefix) :]
+                break
+        if node_id not in self._nodes:
+            raise KeyError(f"Unknown citation: {citation_id}")
+        return self._nodes[node_id].model_copy(deep=True)

+"""Explicit synthetic setup using the existing canonical fixture; never loads raw BMW data."""
+
+from bmwow.ontology import GraphBundle
+from bmwow.ontology.models import SourceDocument
+
+from .config import KnowledgeConfig, ModelProfile, SearchLocale
+from .repository import InMemoryRepository
+from .service import KnowledgeService
+
+
+def create_synthetic_service(bundle: GraphBundle) -> KnowledgeService:
+    sources = [node for node in bundle.nodes if isinstance(node, SourceDocument)]
+    if not sources or any(source.properties.origin != "synthetic" for source in sources):
+        raise ValueError("The synthetic backend accepts only wholly synthetic source documents")
+    note = "Invented application metadata for the integration fixture; no real segment claim."
+    profiles = {
+        node_id: ModelProfile(segment="synthetic_sedan", curation_note=note, sold_regions=["US"])
+        for node_id in (
+            "vehicle:bmw-g60",
+            "vehicle:bmw-g68",
+            "vehicle:bmw-g60-fixture-ev",
+            "vehicle:example-sedan",
+        )
+    }
+    config = KnowledgeConfig(
+        model_profiles=profiles,
+        feature_keys={
+            "feature:parking-controls": "parking_control_usability",
+            "feature:ac-charging": "ac_charging",
+            "feature:electric-range": "electric_range",
+        },
+        search_locales={"US": SearchLocale(country="us", lang="en")},
+        sales_groups={"evidence:fixture-sales": "G60_G68"},
+    )
+    return KnowledgeService(InMemoryRepository(bundle), config)

+"""Generate portable JSON contracts from the Python source of truth."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import get_args
+
+from .models import (
+    ONTOLOGY_VERSION,
+    Domain,
+    GraphBundle,
+    Node,
+    NodeType,
+    RelationshipType,
+    SignalKind,
+    SignalPayload,
+)
+from .relationships import RELATIONSHIPS
+from .tools import build_agent_contracts
+
+
+def build_schema() -> dict:
+    schema = GraphBundle.model_json_schema(mode="validation")
+    schema["$schema"] = "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
+    schema["$id"] = f"urn:bmwow:ontology:{ONTOLOGY_VERSION}"
+    schema["title"] = f"BMW product decision ontology v{ONTOLOGY_VERSION}"
+    schema["description"] = (
+        "Portable property-graph contract generated from Pydantic models. "
+        "Also run bmwow-validate for graph-wide evidence, reference, and review rules."
+    )
+    schema["x-generated-by"] = "uv run bmwow-schema; do not edit this file by hand"
+    return schema
+
+
+def build_vocabulary() -> dict:
+    if set(RELATIONSHIPS) != set(get_args(RelationshipType)):
+        raise RuntimeError("Model and relationship rule names disagree")
+    node_models = get_args(get_args(Node)[0])
+    node_types = {
+        get_args(model.model_fields["type"].annotation)[0]: {"description": model.__doc__}
+        for model in node_models
+    }
+    known_nodes = set(node_types)
+    if known_nodes != set(get_args(NodeType)):
+        raise RuntimeError("Model and query object type names disagree")
+    signal_models = get_args(get_args(SignalPayload)[0])
+    known_signals = {
+        kind
+        for model in signal_models
+        for kind in get_args(model.model_fields["signal_kind"].annotation)
+    }
+    if known_signals != set(get_args(SignalKind)):
+        raise RuntimeError("Model and query signal kind names disagree")
+    for rule in RELATIONSHIPS.values():
+        if not set(rule.source_types + rule.target_types) <= known_nodes:
+            raise RuntimeError("Relationship rule references an unknown node type")
+    return {
+        "ontology_version": ONTOLOGY_VERSION,
+        "node_types": node_types,
+        "relationships": {name: asdict(rule) for name, rule in RELATIONSHIPS.items()},
+        "domains": list(get_args(Domain)),
+        "signal_kinds": list(get_args(SignalKind)),
+        "scope_authority": (
+            "properties.context is authoritative; do not separately maintain conflicting ABOUT edges."
+        ),
+        "review_state": (
+            "Derived from human Decision events for the exact Requirement id and revision. "
+            "A new revision starts unreviewed."
+        ),
+        "link_traversal": (
+            "Store each canonical edge once. Traverse incoming and outgoing sides; "
+            "inverse_name is a display/API label, not a separately stored relationship type."
+        ),
+        "actions": {
+            "propose_requirement": {
+                "input": "RequirementProposal",
+                "function": "bmwow.ontology.validate_proposal",
+                "effect": "Returns a validated candidate snapshot; leaves the base unchanged.",
+                "actor": "software; service binds identity and checks authorization",
+            },
+            "review_requirement": {
+                "input": "Decision + REVIEWS",
+                "function": "bmwow.ontology.validate_bundle on a merged snapshot",
+                "effect": "Records a human decision for one exact requirement revision.",
+                "actor": "authenticated human; not available in the agent proposal interface",
+            },
+        },
+        "storage": (
+            "SQL tables, join tables, or a NetworkX MultiDiGraph can represent the same contract. "
+            "No storage engine is required by this ontology."
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def render_contracts() -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        name: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
+        for name, value in {
+            "schema.json": build_schema(),
+            "vocabulary.json": build_vocabulary(),
+            "agent-contracts.json": build_agent_contracts(),
+        }.items()
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output-dir",
+        type=Path,
+        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "contracts/ontology",
+        help="Contract directory (default: <repo>/contracts/ontology)",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="Fail if generated files are stale")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    failed = False
+    try:
+        contracts = render_contracts()
+        if not args.check:
+            args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        for name, expected in contracts.items():
+            path = args.output_dir / name
+            if args.check:
+                if not path.is_file() or path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != expected:
+                    print(f"STALE {path}; run uv run bmwow-schema")
+                    failed = True
+                else:
+                    print(f"CURRENT {path}")
+            else:
+                path.write_text(expected, encoding="utf-8")
+                print(f"GENERATED {path}")
+    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
+        parser.exit(1, f"{error}\n")
+    raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Deterministic ontology tools, independent of agent orchestration and storage.
+
+Read operations require a valid closed snapshot. Returned slices deliberately are
+not GraphBundles: they may omit unrelated references and report truncation. Service
+code supplies actor binding and snapshot preconditions outside model arguments.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from collections import defaultdict, deque
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Annotated, Literal
+
+from pydantic import Field, ValidationError
+
+from .models import (
+    ONTOLOGY_VERSION,
+    ContractModel,
+    CountryCode,
+    Edge,
+    EngineType,
+    GraphBundle,
+    Id,
+    Node,
+    NodeType,
+    RelationshipType,
+    Requirement,
+    SignalKind,
+    Text,
+    UniqueList,
+)
+from .validation import validate_bundle
+
+Limit = Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=100)]
+
+
+class OntologyQuery(ContractModel):
+    """Find objects using explicit references; filters are ANDed across dimensions."""
+
+    node_types: UniqueList[NodeType] = Field(
+        default_factory=list, description="Empty means all types."
+    )
+    ids: UniqueList[Id] = Field(
+        default_factory=list, description="Exact revision IDs, if specified."
+    )
+    vehicle_model_ids: UniqueList[Id] = Field(
+        default_factory=list,
+        description="Match explicit context references; no generation or variant inference.",
+    )
+    market_ids: UniqueList[Id] = Field(
+        default_factory=list,
+        description="Match explicit context references; unknown scope never matches a requested market.",
+    )
+    country_codes: UniqueList[CountryCode] = Field(
+        default_factory=list,
+        description="Match explicitly observed countries without assigning market membership.",
+    )
+    engine_types: UniqueList[EngineType] = Field(
+        default_factory=list,
+        description="Match explicit engine-type context; unknown is not ICE, PHEV, or BEV.",
+    )
+    feature_ids: UniqueList[Id] = Field(
+        default_factory=list, description="Match outgoing CONCERNS references."
+    )
+    signal_kinds: UniqueList[SignalKind] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    temporal_status: (
+        Literal["historical", "source_reported_future", "forecast", "unknown", "observed", "mixed"]
+        | None
+    ) = Field(
+        default=None,
+        description="Match direct measurement or Trend status. Study/commercial Signals inherit only when every direct Evidence measurement agrees; missing or conflicting inputs are unknown.",
+    )
+    latest_only: bool = Field(
+        default=True,
+        description="Select the highest revision of each logical entity before applying filters.",
+    )
+    limit: Limit = 20
+    offset: Annotated[int, Field(ge=0, le=10000)] = 0
+
+
+class QueryResult(ContractModel):
+    nodes: list[Node]
+    total: int
+    offset: int
+    truncated: bool
+
+
+class TraversalQuery(ContractModel):
+    """Traverse stored relationships in either direction without inventing inverse edges."""
+
+    node_id: Id
+    relationship_types: UniqueList[RelationshipType] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    direction: Literal["incoming", "outgoing", "both"] = "both"
+    max_depth: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=4)] = 1
+    max_nodes: Annotated[int, Field(ge=2, le=200)] = 50
+
+
+class TraceQuery(ContractModel):
+    """Retrieve support, challenges, baselines, premises, and original evidence."""
+
+    node_id: Id
+    max_depth: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1, le=12)] = 8
+    max_nodes: Annotated[int, Field(ge=2, le=500)] = 100
+
+
+class ObjectReference(ContractModel):
+    """A stored property reference; this is not an ontology relationship edge."""
+
+    source_id: Id
+    field: Text
+    target_id: Id
+
+
+class GraphSlice(ContractModel):
+    root_id: Id
+    nodes: list[Node]
+    edges: list[Edge]
+    references: list[ObjectReference] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    truncated: bool
+
+
+class RequirementQuery(ContractModel):
+    requirement_id: Id = Field(
+        description="An exact Requirement revision ID, not a logical entity key."
+    )
+    max_nodes: Annotated[int, Field(ge=2, le=500)] = 100
+
+
+class ReviewState(ContractModel):
+    status: Literal["unreviewed", "approved", "rejected", "changes_requested", "ambiguous"]
+    decision_ids: list[Id]
+    priority: int | None
+    priority_decision_ids: list[Id]
+
+
+class RequirementDossier(ContractModel):
+    requirement: Requirement
+    trace: GraphSlice
+    baseline_ids: list[Id]
+    assumption_ids: list[Id]
+    decisions: list[Node]
+    review: ReviewState
+    truncated: bool
+
+
+class ComparisonQuery(ContractModel):
+    node_ids: Annotated[UniqueList[Id], Field(min_length=2, max_length=20)] = Field(
+        description="Evidence or capability Signal objects with measurements; no implicit unit conversion."
+    )
+
+
+class ComparisonReadiness(ContractModel):
+    node_ids: list[Id]
+    status: Literal["ready_for_review", "not_ready"]
+    blockers: list[Text]
+    cautions: list[Text]
+
+
+class ProposalEdge(Edge):
+    type: Literal[
+        "CONCERNS",
+        "ADDRESSES",
+        "JUSTIFIED_BY",
+        "DEPENDS_ON",
+        "BASELINED_ON",
+        "SUPERSEDES",
+        "SUPPORTS",
+        "CHALLENGES",
+    ]
+
+
+class RequirementProposal(ContractModel):
+    """One software-authored Requirement and links to existing objects; no edits or decisions."""
+
+    requirement: Requirement
+    edges: Annotated[list[ProposalEdge], Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)]
+
+
+class ProposalIssue(ContractModel):
+    code: Literal[
+        "invalid_base",
+        "invalid_structure",
+        "stale_snapshot",
+        "identity_collision",
+        "revision_conflict",
+        "disallowed_change",
+        "invalid_graph",
+    ]
+    message: Text
+
+
+class ProposalResult(ContractModel):
+    accepted: bool = Field(
+        description="Candidate passed validation; this does not mean human approval or persistence."
+    )
+    base_fingerprint: Text | None
+    errors: list[ProposalIssue]
+    candidate: GraphBundle | None
+
+
+def _parse(model, value):
+    data = value.model_dump(mode="json") if isinstance(value, ContractModel) else value
+    return model.model_validate_json(json.dumps(data, allow_nan=False))
+
+
+def _closed(bundle: dict | GraphBundle) -> GraphBundle:
+    errors = validate_bundle(bundle)
+    if errors:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid closed ontology snapshot: " + "; ".join(errors))
+    return _parse(GraphBundle, bundle)
+
+
+def _indices(bundle: GraphBundle):
+    nodes = {node.id: node for node in bundle.nodes}
+    outgoing, incoming = defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list)
+    for edge in sorted(bundle.edges, key=lambda item: (item.type, item.id)):
+        outgoing[edge.source_id].append(edge)
+        incoming[edge.target_id].append(edge)
+    return nodes, outgoing, incoming
+
+
+def _context(node):
+    context = getattr(node.properties, "context", None)
+    return context.model_dump(mode="json") if context else {}
+
+
+def _measurement(node):
+    measurement = getattr(node.properties, "measurement", None)
+    capability = getattr(node.properties, "capability", None)
+    return measurement or (capability.measurement if capability else None)
+
+
+def query_nodes(bundle: dict | GraphBundle, query: OntologyQuery | dict) -> QueryResult:
+    """Retrieve a deterministic page; an OR applies within each reference list.
+
+    Study/commercial Signals inherit a temporal status only when every direct
+    Evidence input has a measurement and all their temporal statuses agree.
+    Missing or mixed inputs remain unknown; no first-input shortcut is applied.
+    """
+    bundle, query = _closed(bundle), _parse(OntologyQuery, query)
+    nodes, outgoing, _ = _indices(bundle)
+    latest = {}
+    for node in nodes.values():
+        latest[node.entity_key] = max(latest.get(node.entity_key, 0), node.revision)
+    matches = []
+    for node in sorted(nodes.values(), key=lambda item: item.id):
+        if query.latest_only and node.revision != latest[node.entity_key]:
+            continue
+        if query.node_types and node.type not in query.node_types:
+            continue
+        if query.ids and node.id not in query.ids:
+            continue
+        context = _context(node)
+        if any(
+            requested and not set(requested).intersection(context.get(field, []))
+            for field, requested in (
+                ("vehicle_model_ids", query.vehicle_model_ids),
+                ("market_ids", query.market_ids),
+                ("country_codes", query.country_codes),
+                ("engine_types", query.engine_types),
+            )
+        ):
+            continue
+        if query.feature_ids and not any(
+            edge.type == "CONCERNS" and edge.target_id in query.feature_ids
+            for edge in outgoing[node.id]
+        ):
+            continue
+        if (
+            query.signal_kinds
+            and getattr(node.properties, "signal_kind", None) not in query.signal_kinds
+        ):
+            continue
+        measurement = _measurement(node)
+        temporal = getattr(node.properties, "temporal_status", None) or (
+            measurement.temporal_status if measurement else None
+        )
+        if measurement is None and getattr(node.properties, "signal_kind", None) in {
+            "study_finding",
+            "commercial_indicator",
+        }:
+            inputs = [
+                nodes[edge.target_id] for edge in outgoing[node.id] if edge.type == "DERIVED_FROM"
+            ]
+            statuses = {
+                input_measurement.temporal_status
+                for item in inputs
+                if (input_measurement := _measurement(item)) is not None
+            }
+            temporal = (
+                next(iter(statuses))
+                if inputs
+                and len(statuses) == 1
+                and all(_measurement(item) is not None for item in inputs)
+                else "unknown"
+            )
+        if query.temporal_status and query.temporal_status != temporal:
+            continue
+        matches.append(node)
+    return QueryResult(
+        nodes=matches[query.offset : query.offset + query.limit],
+        total=len(matches),
+        offset=query.offset,
+        truncated=query.offset + query.limit < len(matches),
+    )
+
+
+def _walk(
+    bundle: GraphBundle,
+    root_id: str,
+    select: Callable,
+    max_depth: int,
+    max_nodes: int,
+    property_references: Callable | None = None,
+) -> GraphSlice:
+    nodes, outgoing, incoming = _indices(bundle)
+    if root_id not in nodes:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown ontology object: {root_id}")
+    visited, edges, references, truncated = {root_id}, {}, {}, False
+    queue = deque([(root_id, 0)])
+    while queue:
+        node_id, depth = queue.popleft()
+        selected = select(nodes[node_id], outgoing[node_id], incoming[node_id])
+        fields = property_references(nodes[node_id]) if property_references else []
+        choices = [
+            (edge.target_id if edge.source_id == node_id else edge.source_id, edge)
+            for edge in selected
+        ]
+        choices += [(reference.target_id, reference) for reference in fields]
+        for neighbor, item in choices:
+            collection = edges if isinstance(item, Edge) else references
+            key = (
+                item.id if isinstance(item, Edge) else (item.source_id, item.field, item.target_id)
+            )
+            if key not in collection and len(edges) + len(references) >= min(max_nodes * 4, 1000):
+                truncated = True
+                continue
+            if depth >= max_depth:
+                if key not in collection:
+                    truncated = True
+                continue
+            if neighbor not in visited:
+                if len(visited) >= max_nodes:
+                    truncated = True
+                    continue
+                visited.add(neighbor)
+                queue.append((neighbor, depth + 1))
+            collection[key] = item
+    return GraphSlice(
+        root_id=root_id,
+        nodes=[nodes[key] for key in sorted(visited)],
+        edges=[edges[key] for key in sorted(edges)],
+        references=[references[key] for key in sorted(references)],
+        truncated=truncated,
+    )
+
+
+def traverse(bundle: dict | GraphBundle, query: TraversalQuery | dict) -> GraphSlice:
+    """Read incoming, outgoing, or both directions; preserve stored edge orientation."""
+    bundle, query = _closed(bundle), _parse(TraversalQuery, query)
+
+    def select(node, outgoing, incoming):
+        choices = ([] if query.direction == "incoming" else outgoing) + (
+            [] if query.direction == "outgoing" else incoming
+        )
+        return [
+            edge
+            for edge in choices
+            if not query.relationship_types or edge.type in query.relationship_types
+        ]
+
+    return _walk(bundle, query.node_id, select, query.max_depth, query.max_nodes)
+
+
+def trace_evidence(bundle: dict | GraphBundle, query: TraceQuery | dict) -> GraphSlice:
+    """Follow all reasoning branches, including challenges to needs and assumptions."""
+    bundle, query = _closed(bundle), _parse(TraceQuery, query)
+    downstream = {
+        "Requirement": {"JUSTIFIED_BY", "ADDRESSES", "BASELINED_ON", "DEPENDS_ON", "CONCERNS"},
+        "CustomerNeed": {"DEPENDS_ON", "CONCERNS"},
+        "Trend": {"DERIVED_FROM", "DEPENDS_ON", "CONCERNS"},
+        "Signal": {"DERIVED_FROM", "DESCRIBES", "CONCERNS"},
+        "CatalogItem": {"DERIVED_FROM", "INCLUDES", "CONCERNS"},
+        "Evidence": {"IN_SOURCE"},
+        "VehicleModel": {"IS_VARIANT_OF"},
+    }
+
+    def select(node, outgoing, incoming):
+        return [edge for edge in incoming if edge.type in {"CHALLENGES", "SUPPORTS"}] + [
+            edge for edge in outgoing if edge.type in downstream.get(node.type, set())
+        ]
+
+    def property_references(node):
+        fields = []
+        context = _context(node)
+        for field in ("vehicle_model_ids", "market_ids"):
+            fields.extend(
+                (f"properties.context.{field}", target) for target in context.get(field, [])
+            )
+        for index, criterion in enumerate(getattr(node.properties, "acceptance_criteria", [])):
+            fields.extend(
+                (f"properties.acceptance_criteria[{index}].supporting_evidence_ids", target)
+                for target in criterion.supporting_evidence_ids
+            )
+        owners = [("properties", node.properties)]
+        capability = getattr(node.properties, "capability", None)
+        if capability:
+            owners.append(("properties.capability", capability))
+        for prefix, owner in owners:
+            for index, condition in enumerate(getattr(owner, "conditions", [])):
+                fields.extend(
+                    (f"{prefix}.conditions[{index}].catalog_item_ids", target)
+                    for target in condition.catalog_item_ids
+                )
+        return [
+            ObjectReference(source_id=node.id, field=field, target_id=target)
+            for field, target in fields
+        ]
+
+    return _walk(
+        bundle, query.node_id, select, query.max_depth, query.max_nodes, property_references
+    )
+
+
+def _review(decisions: list) -> ReviewState:
+    reviews = [
+        node
+        for node in decisions
+        if node.properties.action in {"approve", "reject", "request_changes"}
+    ]
+    priorities = [node for node in decisions if node.properties.action == "set_priority"]
+    latest_review = max((node.properties.decided_at for node in reviews), default=None)
+    latest_priority = max((node.properties.decided_at for node in priorities), default=None)
+    current = [node for node in reviews if node.properties.decided_at == latest_review]
+    priority_events = [node for node in priorities if node.properties.decided_at == latest_priority]
+    actions = {node.properties.action for node in current}
+    values = {node.properties.priority for node in priority_events}
+    status = (
+        "unreviewed"
+        if not actions
+        else "ambiguous"
+        if len(actions) > 1
+        else {"approve": "approved", "reject": "rejected", "request_changes": "changes_requested"}[
+            next(iter(actions))
+        ]
+    )
+    return ReviewState(
+        status=status,
+        decision_ids=sorted(node.id for node in current),
+        priority=next(iter(values)) if len(values) == 1 else None,
+        priority_decision_ids=sorted(node.id for node in priority_events),
+    )
+
+
+def get_requirement_context(
+    bundle: dict | GraphBundle, query: RequirementQuery | dict
+) -> RequirementDossier:
+    """Assemble a bounded dossier; review applies only to the requested revision."""
+    bundle, query = _closed(bundle), _parse(RequirementQuery, query)
+    nodes, outgoing, incoming = _indices(bundle)
+    requirement = nodes.get(query.requirement_id)
+    if requirement is None or requirement.type != "Requirement":
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected an exact Requirement revision: {query.requirement_id}")
+    decisions = sorted(
+        (nodes[edge.source_id] for edge in incoming[requirement.id] if edge.type == "REVIEWS"),
+        key=lambda node: (node.properties.decided_at, node.id),
+    )
+    trace = trace_evidence(bundle, TraceQuery(node_id=requirement.id, max_nodes=query.max_nodes))
+    baselines = sorted(
+        edge.target_id for edge in outgoing[requirement.id] if edge.type == "BASELINED_ON"
+    )
+    review = _review(decisions)
+    review = review.model_copy(
+        update={
+            "decision_ids": review.decision_ids[: query.max_nodes],

+def comparison_readiness(

+        for node_id in query.node_ids

+        if any(capability is None for _, capability in capabilities):

+                "Some objects have no capability-availability metadata; review configuration applicability"
+            )

+        for field in ("availability", "variant", "conditions"):

+                        for capability in populated

+                )

+            ):

+                    f"Capabilities differ in {field}; configuration alternatives are not interchangeable"
+                )

+    for node_id in query.node_ids:

+                )

+        node_ids=query.node_ids,

+def snapshot_fingerprint(bundle: dict | GraphBundle) -> str:
+    """Content fingerprint, insensitive to object/link ordering; not authentication."""
+    data = _closed(bundle).model_dump(mode="json")
+    data["nodes"].sort(key=lambda node: node["id"])

+def validate_proposal(
+    bundle: dict | GraphBundle,

+        errors.append(ProposalIssue(code=code, message=message))

+        issue("identity_collision", "An existing object ID cannot be replaced")
+    for edge in proposal.edges:
+        if edge.id in edge_ids:
+            issue(
+                "identity_collision", f"{edge.id}: an existing relationship ID cannot be replaced"
+            )

+        incoming = edge.target_id == requirement.id

+            outgoing
+            and edge.type not in {"SUPPORTS", "CHALLENGES"}
+            or incoming
+            and edge.type in {"SUPPORTS", "CHALLENGES"}
+        )
+        other_id = edge.target_id if outgoing else edge.source_id

+                "disallowed_change",
+                f"{edge.id}: proposal links must connect the proposed Requirement to existing objects in the permitted direction",
+            )

+    if provenance.actor_type != "software":
+        issue("disallowed_change", "Agent proposals cannot claim human authorship")
+    if actor_id is not None and provenance.actor_id != actor_id:
+        issue("disallowed_change", "Recorded proposal actor does not match the service-bound actor")
+    if any(
+        criterion.basis == "human_set_target"
+        for criterion in requirement.properties.acceptance_criteria
+    ):
+        issue("disallowed_change", "Agent proposals cannot set human-authored acceptance targets")

+    supersedes = [edge for edge in proposal.edges if edge.type == "SUPERSEDES"]

+        latest = max(history, key=lambda node: node.revision)
+        if latest.type != "Requirement" or requirement.revision != latest.revision + 1:
+            issue(
+                "revision_conflict",
+                "A proposal must be the next revision of the same Requirement entity",
+            )
+        if len(supersedes) != 1 or supersedes[0].target_id != latest.id:
+            issue(
+                "revision_conflict",
+                "A revised proposal must SUPERSEDES exactly the latest Requirement revision",
+            )
+    elif requirement.revision != 1 or supersedes:
+        issue(
+            "revision_conflict", "A new Requirement entity starts at revision 1 without SUPERSEDES"
+        )

+        return ProposalResult(
+            accepted=False, base_fingerprint=fingerprint, errors=errors, candidate=None
+        )
+    candidate_data = base.model_dump(mode="json")
+    candidate_data["nodes"].append(requirement.model_dump(mode="json"))
+    candidate_data["edges"].extend(edge.model_dump(mode="json") for edge in proposal.edges)
+    for message in validate_bundle(candidate_data):
+        issue("invalid_graph", message)

+        accepted=not errors, base_fingerprint=fingerprint, errors=errors, candidate=candidate
+    )

+def build_agent_contracts() -> dict:
+    """Export narrow tool inputs and portable results; complete graphs remain separate."""
+
+    def schema(model, mode):

+        "x-generated-by": "uv run bmwow-schema; do not edit this file by hand",
+        "description": "Framework-neutral agent inputs; graph access, actor identity, and snapshot preconditions are service-bound. Structure validation never replaces merged graph validation.",

+            name: schema(model, "validation")

+def _measurement_errors(measurement: dict, as_of: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Apply identical quantitative rules to observations and capability claims."""
+    errors = []
+    value, interval = measurement["value"], measurement["value_range"]
+    if (value is None) == (interval is None):
+        return ["measurement needs exactly one scalar value or value_range"]
+    values = [value] if value is not None else [interval["minimum"], interval["maximum"]]
+    if interval and interval["minimum"] > interval["maximum"]:
+        errors.append("measurement range minimum exceeds maximum")
+    statistic = measurement["statistic"]
+    if statistic == "proportion" and any(not 0 <= number <= 1 for number in values):
+        errors.append("proportion must be in [0, 1]")
+    if statistic == "percent" and any(not 0 <= number <= 100 for number in values):
+        errors.append("percent must be in [0, 100]")
+    if statistic == "count" and any(number < 0 or int(number) != number for number in values):
+        errors.append("count must be a nonnegative integer")
+    scale = measurement["scale"]
+    if scale and (
+        scale["minimum"] >= scale["maximum"]
+        or any(not scale["minimum"] <= number <= scale["maximum"] for number in values)
+    ):
+        errors.append("invalid measurement scale or value outside scale")
+    period = measurement["period"]
+    if period:
+        if period["start"] and period["end"] and period["start"] > period["end"]:
+            errors.append("period starts after it ends")
+        future = (
+            (period["start"] and period["start"] > as_of)
+            or (period["end"] and period["end"] > as_of)
+        ) or (
+            period["label"].isdigit()
+            and len(period["label"]) == 4
+            and int(period["label"]) > int(as_of[:4])

+            errors.append("future measurements cannot be historical")

+def _cyclic_nodes(adjacency: dict[str, list[str]]) -> set[str]:

+    cyclic = set()
+    for start in adjacency:
+        pending = list(adjacency[start])
+        seen = set()
+        while pending:
+            current = pending.pop()
+            if current == start:
+                cyclic.add(start)
+                break
+            if current not in seen:
+                seen.add(current)
+                pending.extend(adjacency.get(current, []))

+            errors.append(f"{node_id}: missing or cyclic evidence chain")
+
+        if kind == "CatalogItem":
+            documents = document_ids(node_id)
+            if len(documents) != 1:
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: CatalogItem needs exactly one original source edition")
+            if any(
+                nodes[source_id]["properties"]["source_kind"]
+                not in {"product_catalog", "competitor_official"}
+                for source_id in documents
+            ):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: CatalogItem needs an original product catalog source")
+            check_conditions(node_id, props["conditions"], documents)
+            children = targets(node_id, "INCLUDES")
+            if children and props["item_kind"] != "package":
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: only a package can include catalog items")
+            for child in children:
+                if document_ids(child["id"]) != documents:
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: package membership crosses source editions")
+
+        if kind in {"CustomerNeed", "Requirement"} and not features(node_id):
+            errors.append(f"{node_id}: {kind} needs at least one CONCERNS Feature relationship")
+
+        if kind == "Signal":
+            allowed_sources = {
+                "customer_feedback": {"feedback_dataset"},
+                "public_sentiment": {"public_discussion", "editorial_review"},
+                "competitor_capability": {
+                    "competitor_official",
+                    "editorial_review",
+                    "product_catalog",
+                },
+                "product_capability": {
+                    "product_catalog",
+                    "competitor_official",
+                    "editorial_review",
+                },
+                "study_finding": {"customer_study"},
+                "commercial_indicator": {"sales_dataset"},
+                "trend_indicator": {"industry_report", "global_indicator", "editorial_review"},
+            }
+            for evidence in targets(node_id, "DERIVED_FROM"):
+                if evidence["type"] != "Evidence":
+                    continue
+                for source in targets(evidence["id"], "IN_SOURCE"):
+                    if (
+                        source["type"] == "SourceDocument"
+                        and source["properties"]["source_kind"]
+                        not in allowed_sources[props["signal_kind"]]
+                    ):
+                        errors.append(f"{node_id}: source kind does not match signal kind")
+            if props["signal_kind"] in {"competitor_capability", "product_capability"}:
+                if not context["vehicle_model_ids"]:
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: product or competitor capability needs a model reference"
+                    )
+                if not features(node_id):
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: capability needs at least one CONCERNS Feature relationship"
+                    )
+                if props["epistemic_status"] != "publisher_claim":
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: capability must retain publisher_claim epistemic status"
+                    )
+            capability = props["capability"]
+            is_capability = props["signal_kind"] in {"competitor_capability", "product_capability"}
+            if capability and not is_capability:
+                errors.append(
+                    f"{node_id}: only a capability Signal can contain a capability payload"
+                )
+            if props["public_context"] and props["signal_kind"] != "public_sentiment":
+                errors.append(
+                    f"{node_id}: only a public_sentiment Signal can contain public_context"
+                )
+            if capability:
+                if capability["variant"] is not None and any(
+                    model_id in nodes
+                    and nodes[model_id]["type"] == "VehicleModel"
+                    and nodes[model_id]["properties"]["variant"] is not None
+                    and nodes[model_id]["properties"]["variant"] != capability["variant"]
+                    for model_id in context["vehicle_model_ids"]
+                ):
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: capability variant disagrees with the scoped model variant"
+                    )
+                check_conditions(node_id, capability["conditions"], document_ids(node_id))
+                if capability["measurement"]:
+                    errors.extend(
+                        f"{node_id}: capability measurement: {error}"
+                        for error in _measurement_errors(capability["measurement"], bundle["as_of"])
+                    )
+            described_items = targets(node_id, "DESCRIBES")
+            if len(described_items) > 1:
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: a capability Signal describes at most one CatalogItem")
+            for item in described_items:
+                if props["signal_kind"] not in {"product_capability", "competitor_capability"}:
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: only a capability Signal can describe a CatalogItem")
+                if document_ids(node_id) != document_ids(item["id"]):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: described catalog item crosses source editions")
+
+        if kind == "Trend":
+            if props["horizon"]["from_year"] > props["horizon"]["to_year"]:
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: invalid trend horizon")
+            if props["temporal_status"] in {"forecast", "mixed"} and not targets(
+                node_id, "DEPENDS_ON"
+            ):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: projected Trend needs an explicit Assumption")
+
+        if kind == "Requirement":
+            launch_year = props["target_launch_year"]
+            creation_year = datetime.fromisoformat(
+                props["provenance"]["created_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")
+            ).year
+            if launch_year is not None and launch_year != creation_year + props["horizon_years"]:
+                errors.append(
+                    f"{node_id}: target launch year must match requirement creation year plus horizon_years"
+                )
+            if not context["vehicle_model_ids"] or not context["market_ids"]:
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: Requirement needs baseline models and target markets")
+            for model_id in context["vehicle_model_ids"]:
+                model = nodes.get(model_id)
+                if (
+                    model
+                    and model["type"] == "VehicleModel"
+                    and model["properties"]["brand"].casefold() != "bmw"
+                ):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: successor baseline must be a BMW model")
+            needs, justifications = targets(node_id, "ADDRESSES"), targets(node_id, "JUSTIFIED_BY")
+            if not needs or not all(reaches_evidence(n["id"]) for n in needs):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: Requirement must address an evidenced CustomerNeed")
+            if not justifications or not all(reaches_evidence(n["id"]) for n in justifications):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: Requirement needs traceable justifications")
+            if not targets(node_id, "DEPENDS_ON"):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: successor proposal needs a forward-looking Assumption")
+            baselines = targets(node_id, "BASELINED_ON")
+            status, intent = props["baseline_status"], props["change_intent"]
+            if intent in {"improve", "retain", "remove"} and status != "known_present":
+                errors.append(
+                    f"{node_id}: improve, retain, or remove requires a known_present baseline"
+                )
+            if intent == "introduce" and status == "known_present":
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: introduce cannot use a known_present baseline")
+            if status in {"known_present", "known_absent"} and not baselines:
+                errors.append(
+                    f"{node_id}: known baseline status requires explicit BASELINED_ON evidence"
+                )
+            for baseline in baselines:
+                baseline_props = baseline["properties"]
+                if baseline_props["signal_kind"] != "product_capability":
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: BASELINED_ON must target a product_capability Signal"
+                    )
+                if not reaches_evidence(baseline["id"]):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: baseline needs a traceable evidence chain")
+                if not features(node_id) & features(baseline["id"]):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: baseline must share a canonical Feature")
+                model_ids = baseline_props["context"]["vehicle_model_ids"]
+                if not model_ids or any(
+                    model_id not in nodes
+                    or nodes[model_id]["type"] != "VehicleModel"
+                    or nodes[model_id]["properties"]["brand"].casefold() != "bmw"
+                    or not family_model_ids(model_id) & set(context["vehicle_model_ids"])
+                    for model_id in model_ids
+                ):
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: baseline capability must describe the BMW baseline model or variant"
+                    )
+                capability = baseline_props["capability"]
+                availability = capability["availability"] if capability else "unknown"
+                if status == "known_present" and availability not in {
+                    "standard",
+                    "optional",
+                    "available_unspecified",
+                }:
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: known_present requires an explicitly available capability"
+                    )
+                if status == "known_absent" and availability != "unavailable":
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: known_absent requires explicit unavailable capability evidence"
+                    )
+            if node["revision"] > 1:
+                previous = targets(node_id, "SUPERSEDES")
+                if len(previous) != 1 or previous[0]["revision"] != node["revision"] - 1:
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{node_id}: Requirement revision must SUPERSEDES its consecutive previous revision"
+                    )
+            for criterion in props["acceptance_criteria"]:
+                if criterion["target"] is not None and any(
+                    criterion[field] is None for field in ("metric", "operator", "unit")
+                ):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: numeric criterion needs metric, operator, and unit")
+                if (
+                    criterion["basis"] == "evidence_supported_target"
+                    and not criterion["supporting_evidence_ids"]
+                ):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: evidence-supported target needs explicit evidence")
+                for evidence_id in criterion["supporting_evidence_ids"]:
+                    if evidence_id not in nodes or nodes[evidence_id]["type"] != "Evidence":
+                        errors.append(f"{node_id}: invalid criterion evidence reference")
+                if (
+                    criterion["basis"] == "human_set_target"
+                    and props["provenance"]["actor_type"] != "human"
+                ):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: human-set target requires recorded human authorship")
+                if (
+                    criterion["verification_method"] != "to_be_defined"
+                    and not criterion["test_conditions"]
+                ):
+                    errors.append(f"{node_id}: verified criterion needs explicit test conditions")
+
+        if kind == "Decision":
+            reviewed = targets(node_id, "REVIEWS")
+            if len(reviewed) != 1:
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: Decision must review exactly one Requirement")
+            elif props["requirement_revision"] != reviewed[0]["revision"]:
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: Decision targets the wrong requirement revision")
+            elif reviewed[0]["type"] == "Requirement" and datetime.fromisoformat(
+                props["decided_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")
+            ) < datetime.fromisoformat(
+                reviewed[0]["properties"]["provenance"]["created_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")
+            ):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: Decision predates the requirement revision")
+            if (props["action"] == "set_priority") != (props["priority"] is not None):
+                errors.append(f"{node_id}: priority is required only for set_priority")
+
+    return errors
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("bundles", nargs="+", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    failed = False
+    for path in args.bundles:
+        try:
+            bundle = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            errors = validate_bundle(bundle)
+        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+            errors = [f"{type(error).__name__}: could not read a JSON bundle"]
+        if errors:
+            failed = True
+            print(f"INVALID {path}")
+            for error in errors:
+                print(f"  {error}")
+        else:
+            print(
+                f"VALID {path}: {len(bundle['nodes'])} nodes, {len(bundle['edges'])} relationships"
+            )
+    raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
